svg.text: An optional agents/openai.yaml file
interface: display name, icons, brand color
policy: allow_implicit_invocation
dependencies: tools, such as an MCP server
Codex reads skills from .agents/skills folders

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ANTHROPIC ADDS: CLAUDE CODE

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Extra fields in the SKILL.md frontmatter
disable-model-invocation, user-invocable
when_to_use, context, paths
model, effort, hooks
Claude Code reads skills from .claude/skills folders
The manual-only switch lives in a different place in each product:
allow_implicit_invocation: false in agents/openai.yaml (Codex) | disable-model-invocation: true in SKILL.md (Claude Code)
